en.p: In the coordinate plane, a point P moves on the line $y=2x-3$. For the two points $\mathrm{A}(c,\,0)$ and $\mathrm{B}(-c,\,0)\ (c>0)$, when the coordinates of point P that maximize the value of $\overline{\mathrm{PB}}-\overline{\mathrm{PA}}$ are $(3,\,3)$, what is the value of the constant $c$? [4 points]
